history_short: Kohhran Pavalai Pawl chu kohhran mipa member te tan buatsaih a ni a. Inkhawm dan, Pathian biak dan leh kohhran hmasawnna tan an thawhlawm a nih.
history_full:
KPP chu kohhran mipa te fellowship a ni a, Bible zir dan leh inkhawm hmang hian member te Pathian biak dan an hmasawn thei a nih.

Tun dinhmun ah chuan member zat a chungtla a, kohhran tan thawhlawm zawng zawng ah an inpe hle a nih.
